title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters, allowing only two hits in Boston's 13-1 win over the Athletics.
The Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games, improving their season record to 64-51.
Boston's offense tallied 15 hits, including a five-run second inning, to overpower Athletics at Fenway Park.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are honing their skills against each other at Patriots training camp.
The pair's matchups include trash talk, seen as preparation for Gonzalez by facing multiple star receivers in 2026.
Gonzalez actively trains despite seeking a new contract, with New England indicating interest in a lucrative deal.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman will begin a rehab assignment with the Triple-A Worcester Red Sox on Saturday.
Rutschman was sidelined due to left wrist inflammation, placed on the IL by the Orioles on July 20.
Rutschman, a three-time All-Star, was acquired from the Orioles for three prospects and Carlos Narvaez.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' (2026) streams on Paramount+, featuring Aang and an ancient warrior played by Dave Bautista.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4 returns on Apple TV, with Jason Sudeikis coaching a women's team at AFC Richmond.
'You, Me & Tuscany' stars Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page, available on Peacock, set in the Italian countryside.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet, recovering from injuries, may pitch in the Red Sox bullpen rather than the starting rotation in 2026.
Interim manager Chad Tracy suggests Crochet won't exceed six innings in outings, indicating a bullpen role is more feasible.
Crochet has started short tosses, marking progress in his recovery, and is open to contributing as a reliever this season.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named "Tippy" was found in a cage near a community food garden in Dorchester.
Residents contacted Boston Animal Care and Control after spotting Tippy near the raised garden beds on Ellington Street.
The python is now at the City’s animal care facility in Roslindale in good condition awaiting identification.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Team Blue, led by Tommy DeVito, defeated Drake Maye's Team White 22-15 in Patriots' training camp scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas excelled for Team Blue, snagging six catches and two touchdowns, including a 50-yard reception.
Injury updates: Carlton Davis remains sidelined, unlikely to play in preseason opener; Will Campbell expected back next week.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by over 850 Boston.com readers.
Harwich features nearly 11 miles of tidal shoreline and more than 20 beaches along the Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay.
Key attractions include The Port Restaurant's oyster specials, scenic views from Saquatucket Marina, and Cape Cod Lavender Farm.

title: DA’s office says prosecutor’s ‘hot mic’ moment in Lindsay Clancy trial was misheard
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Plymouth County DA's office claims 'shut it off' was misheard as 'shut her up' during Lindsay Clancy trial.
Defense attorney Kevin Reddington alleges prosecutors made the comment as Clancy sobbed in court.
Judge William Sullivan warned courtroom attendees against inappropriate comments after the incident.

title: Little boy dancing to DJ on Boston Common has hundreds of thousands of new fans
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Four-year-old Chukwuemeka Ikesinachi-Nwogwugwu's dance at a Boston Common DJ event gained over 200,000 social media likes.
DJ Miss S. Peace's popup show aimed to encourage connection as Chukwuemeka danced alongside attendee Kelly Werme.
Chukwuemeka's mother, Chidimma Ikesinachi, praised Boston's welcoming nature after a supportive encounter at the event.
